name: CUB Form Database Manager
author: Vijaysinh Rathod

sections.description:
CUB – CF7DB is a comprehensive solution for storing and managing Contact Form 7 submissions in your WordPress database. This plugin bridges the gap between form submissions and data management, providing you with powerful tools to handle your form data effectively.

Key Features

  • Automatic Form Data Storage: Every form submission is automatically saved to your database
  • User-Friendly Interface: Clean and intuitive admin interface for managing submissions
  • Advanced Search & Filter: Quickly find specific entries with powerful search capabilities
  • Multiple Export Formats: Export your data in CSV, PDF, Excel formats
  • Print Functionality: Direct printing of form submissions
  • Secure Data Handling: Implements WordPress security best practices
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Form Analytics: Basic analytics to track submission trends
  • Multi-Form Support: Handle multiple Contact Form 7 forms

Pro Features (Coming Soon)

  • Advanced Analytics Dashboard
  • Custom Field Mapping
  • Automated Reports
  • API Access
  • Enhanced Security Features
  • Custom Export Templates

Usage

  1. After activation, find the CUB - CF7DB menu in your WordPress admin panel
  2. Select any Contact Form 7 form to view its submissions
  3. Use the search and filter options to find specific entries
  4. Export data using the available export options (CSV, PDF, Excel)
  5. Configure display settings for the entries table

Support and Custom Development

If you need customization for this plugin or want to develop a new plugin or website, feel free to contact us. We offer professional WordPress development services tailored to your needs.

* Email: contact@cubsys.com
* Support: https://www.cubsys.com/support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cubcf7db folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated
  4. Configure the settings from the CF7DB menu in the WordPress admin area
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all versions of Contact Form 7?

Yes, CUB – CF7DB is compatible with all recent versions of Contact Form 7 (version 5.0 and above).

How can I export my form data?

You can export your form data in multiple formats:
* CSV format for spreadsheet applications
* PDF format for professional reports
* Excel format for detailed analysis
* Direct print option for physical copies

Is there a limit to the number of form submissions I can store?

There is no hard limit imposed by the plugin. The actual limit depends on your hosting environment and database capacity.

Can I delete individual form submissions?

Yes, you can delete individual entries or bulk delete multiple entries from the admin interface.
